prompts.objects: Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite sheet, strict original Commodore Amiga 1991 pixel art. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, transparent background, one fully separated object per cell, generous padding. HARD chunky square pixels, 32-color copper/indigo/magenta/moss palette, strong dark outlines, ordered dithering; draw as if native 256x192 then nearest-neighbor enlarge, NO smooth digital painting, NO antialias, NO photographic rendering. Row 1: rusty faded blue long Finnish tour bus seen DIRECTLY FROM ABOVE pointing UP, rectangular roof windows and mirrors; brown antlered moose crossing sideways left leg forward seen from above; same moose right leg forward; cracked asphalt pothole with gravel rim. Row 2: green pine tree top-down; birch tree top-down; red Lada car seen DIRECTLY FROM ABOVE pointing UP; weathered red petrol pump with black hose. Row 3: silver-blue arcade player spacecraft pointing UP; green horned alien invader; purple large alien mothership boss; glowing amber fuel can. Crisp readable silhouettes at 32-64 pixels. No letters, labels, grid lines, UI, or background.
prompts.scenes: Use case: stylized-concept. Exactly 2 columns x 2 rows of four distinct game backgrounds, equal rectangular panels, NO borders/text/UI/characters. Original 1991 Amiga adventure game pixel art at native 320x180 enlarged with nearest neighbor: clearly visible square pixels, limited 32-color indigo, violet, magenta, rusty copper, moss green palette, strong silhouettes and ordered dithering. Absolutely no smooth painting or photographic detail. TOP LEFT: Finnish pine-and-birch woodland road seen straight from overhead, asphalt road runs vertically from top to bottom through center third, dense forest and gravel shoulders along both sides, no vehicles or lane markings. TOP RIGHT: Finnish rural petrol station at purple-orange midnight sunset, SIDE VIEW full scene, small weathered wooden kiosk with striped awning on left, illuminated canopy and old red pump on right, wide empty gravel forecourt across foreground for parked bus and characters, pine silhouettes behind. BOTTOM LEFT: empty rock stage with amps, drums, copper spotlights and purple curtains, frontal side view, wooden stage floor lower third, no people. BOTTOM RIGHT: top-down grassy campsite with gravel footpaths, small lake along top, birches and olive tents around edges, large clear central grass area for gameplay. Rich crafted pixel textures similar to early 1990s Amiga adventure games and the Midnight Sun Tour title. Four panels fill exact quadrants.
prompts.band: Use case: stylized-concept. Original game character sprite atlas for Mikko Levon's Midnight Sun Tour, very retro Amiga 1991 pixel art, exact 4 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells on TRANSPARENT background. Native 64x64 portrait cells / 32x48 full-body pixel sprites, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor blocks. Clear square pixels, dark indigo outlines, 32-color copper skin, brown, gray, faded denim, black leather, purple highlight palette, restrained ordered dithering. NO airbrush, smooth shading, photorealism or glamorous young faces. Four Finnish rock musicians around age 45-60, lined tired faces, heavy eyelids, scruffy hair, lived-in clothes, some beer bellies. Identity left to right: MIKKO black shaggy hair, full black beard, visible tired eyes NO sunglasses, battered black leather jacket over gray shirt exactly like a grizzled road musician; PEKKA unkempt long blond hair, thinning crown, blond-red stubble, worn denim; RISTO dark long gray-streaked hair and scruffy beard, black vest, slightly heavy-set; HANNELE tousled dark reddish hair, tired lined face, faded band T-shirt and worn jeans, not glamorous. ROW 1: four close-up bust portraits in that order. ROW 2: four full-body standing sprites in that order, faces readable, front-three-quarter view. ROW 3: Mikko running left leg forward; Mikko running right leg forward; Hannele walking left leg forward; Hannele walking right leg forward. Maintain same identities between portrait and body rows. Every figure completely inside its cell, no overlap. No labels/text/grid/borders.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Retro 1991 Amiga pixel-art object sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows equal square cells, transparent background, 12 separate objects, no overlap. Draw at native 64x64 per object, hard chunky square pixels and 32 colors only: indigo black outlines, copper brown, muted teal, moss green, purple highlights. Strong readable silhouettes, ordered dithering, NO smooth painting or antialias. Row 1: battered guitar amplifier; blue drum kit; pair of tall black PA speakers; cardboard box of band T-shirts and cassettes. Row 2: long black guitar case; spare bus tire; green beer bottle crate; pitched olive camping tent. Row 3: analog four-channel silver mixing console; little wooden ferry raft seen top-down; short wooden plank bridge seen top-down; small orange campfire on stones. Consistent three-quarter game prop view except ferry/bridge explicitly top-down. Worn real Finnish rock-band roadtrip gear. No lettering, labels, background, borders or grid.
prompts.performers: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Amiga 1991 pixel-art rock band PERFORMANCE sprite atlas. TRANSPARENT background, exact 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal square cells, every musician and instrument fully within its cell with empty padding. Native 48x64 sprites enlarged in hard square pixels, limited 32-color indigo/copper/faded-denim palette, ordered dithering, no smooth painting, antialias or photorealism. Four weathered Finnish musicians age 45-60, tired lined faces, shaggy hair, lived-in clothes: COLUMN 1 Mikko, shaggy black hair and full black beard, battered black leather jacket over gray shirt, singing into a wired handheld microphone. COLUMN 2 Pekka, scruffy long thinning blond hair and reddish stubble, denim jacket, playing amber electric guitar. COLUMN 3 Risto, long dark gray-streaked hair and graying beard, black vest, beer belly, playing dark bass guitar. COLUMN 4 Hannele, tousled dark reddish hair and lined tired face, faded band T-shirt, seated at small blue drum kit playing with sticks. ROW 1 first playing pose; ROW 2 alternate animation pose: singer leans into mic, guitarist strums down, bassist plucks, drummer raises one stick. Consistent body size and bottom-aligned feet/drum kit across poses. Clearly recognizable instruments, readable coarse pixel silhouettes at small game size. No letters, text, grid lines or UI.
